Baked Rice Pudding Recipe
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 11:21pm

Ingredients




2 eggs, slightly beaten
 cup sugar
2 1/4 cups milk
1 teaspoon vanilla
1/4 cup raisins
1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
2/3 cup Minute Rice
1/2 teaspoon salt

Preparation

1 Set oven to 350 degrees F. Place ingredients in an ungreased 1 1/2 quart round casserole. Set casserole in a pie pan of hot water. Place pans in oven for 45 minutes. Mixture will be set around the edge. Remove from oven. Stir gently. Let cool 1/2 hour without stirring. Serve warm or cold. 2 Makes 4 servings.
